alert.title: Stale features are shifting the forecast baseline
alert.desc: The clean-feed group uses an outdated fleet service age. Compare retraining with an interim correction.

rca.finding: For this separate urban delivery mobility group, the sample feeds are complete. The fleet service age has not been refreshed for ten weeks, and its drift score is 0.76 against a 0.55 review threshold. Synthetic demand exceeds forecasts across three successive cycles. A refreshed feature set and model retrain are recommended; a time-limited correction is proposed while the change is reviewed.
evidence: This group uses a separate validated feed: completeness 0.97 with no rejected files.
Synthetic feature: fleet service age · drift 0.76 > 0.55.
Illustrative wMAPE: 8.6% → 10.4% → 12.7% across three cycles.
Underforecast bias (actual minus forecast, divided by actual): +0.06 → +0.10 → +0.15.
Historical example DEMO-TL-02-H supports refreshing the feature before retraining.

actions.title: Review retrain recommendation

actions.title: Review interim correction
actions.desc: Proposed +11% correction for two sample cycles, with an explicit expiry and weekly review. No override is applied.

actions.title: Escalate missing refresh ownership
actions.desc: Agree who owns feature refreshes and who can approve future model changes. This recurring issue merits a tracked decision.
